#image("/imgs/ap-calc-ab-2002-form-b-frq-01-diagram-01.png", width: 65%)

Let $R$ be the region bounded by the $y$-axis and the graphs of $y = frac(x^(3),1 + x^(2))$ and $y = 4 - 2 x$, as shown in the figure above.

(a) Find the area of $R$.

(b) Find the volume of the solid generated when $R$ is revolved about the $x$-axis.

(c) The region $R$ is the base of a solid. For this solid, each cross section perpendicular to the $x$-axis is a square. Find the volume of this solid.
